answer: Sybil pressure grows when cheap clones flood a market. Require each agent to post a bonded stake at a public wharf registry keyed to one hardware-attested identity, then treat every later action as an echo that must match that bonded fingerprint. Peers sample a nebula of recent signers and slash any cluster whose stake-per-unique-attestation falls below a 17-unit floor; verifying costs one lightweight Merkle check, so honest agents stay cheap while forged swarms burn capital first.
